Brazil Predicted Lineup: Projected XI for 2026 World Cup
[...]
The World Cup is edging closer, with countries confirming their final squads for this summer. Brazil will be thought of as one of the favourites for this summer’s competition. Looking ahead to the competition, we look at the Brazil predicted lineup for the 2026 World Cup, ahead of their opening match with Morocco on June 13.
[...]
## Brazil Predicted Lineup for 2026 World Cup
[...]
Ancelotti had previously said he “ will only call up players who are physically ready” to compete at the highest level. When he made the announcement, the Brazil boss gave a huge vote of confidence for 34-year-old Neymar, confirming he had made the final 26.
[...]
The Italian manager confirmed Thiago Silva, Estevao, and Chelsea attacker Joao Pedro had not made the squad. The squad confirmation certainly got the masses talking, but Ancelotti made his choices.

## Matheus Cunha Offers
[...]
Matheus Cunha is likely to lead the line because of his movement and link-up play. Unlike traditional Brazilian strikers from previous generations, Cunha contributes heavily outside the penalty area. He drops deep to connect midfield and attack, creates space for runners, and presses defenders aggressively. This tactical flexibility suits Ancelotti’s system perfectly.
[...]
## Neymar’s Role Could Change The Tournament
[...]
Although not expected to start every match, Neymar remains one of the most important figures in the squad. Injuries have limited his consistency in recent years, but his creativity and experience are still elite.
[...]
Ancelotti may use Neymar strategically as an impact substitute or rotational starter. If fully fit, he can completely change games with one moment of brilliance. His leadership and experience in pressure situations could also prove valuable inside the dressing room. Brazil’s younger players will benefit from having one of the country’s greatest modern players alongside them during the tournament.
